product_action_navigation_target_exclusi.name: product_action_navigation_target_exclusive_check
product_action_navigation_target_exclusi.value: NOT ("product_action"."navigate_category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_action"."navigate_product_id" IS NOT NULL)

product_action_navigation_target_type_ch.name: product_action_navigation_target_type_check
product_action_navigation_target_type_ch.value: "product_action"."action_type" = 'NAVIGATE_CATALOG' OR ("product_action"."navigate_category_id" IS NULL AND "product_action"."navigate_product_id" IS NULL)

cart_quote_consistency_check.name: cart_quote_consistency_check
cart_quote_consistency_check.value:
(
        ("cart"."quote_subtotal" IS NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_delivery_fee" IS NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_total" IS NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_currency" IS NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_snapshot" IS NULL
          AND "cart"."quoted_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("cart"."quote_subtotal" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_delivery_fee" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_total" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_currency" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_snapshot" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quoted_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cart"."quote_subtotal" >= 0
          AND "cart"."quote_delivery_fee" >= 0
          AND "cart"."quote_total" = "cart"."quote_subtotal" + "cart"."quote_delivery_fee")
      )

order_merchant_progress_check.name: order_merchant_progress_check
order_merchant_progress_check.value:
(
        ("order"."status" = 'placed'
          AND "order"."accepted_at" IS NULL
          AND "order"."preparing_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."status" = 'accepted'
          AND "order"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "order"."preparing_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."status" = 'preparing'
          AND "order"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "order"."preparing_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."status" = 'cancelled')
      )

order_cancellation_state_check.name: order_cancellation_state_check
order_cancellation_state_check.value:
(
        ("order"."status" = 'cancelled'
          AND "order"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim("order"."cancellation_reason") <> ''
          AND "order"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."status" <> 'cancelled'
          AND "order"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL
          AND "order"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
      )

order_shipping_state_check.name: order_shipping_state_check
order_shipping_state_check.value:
(
        ("order"."fulfillment_status" = 'unfulfilled'
          AND "order"."handed_to_shipping_at" IS NULL
          AND "order"."delivered_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."fulfillment_status" = 'handed_to_shipping'
          AND "order"."delivered_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("order"."fulfillment_status" = 'delivered'
          AND (
            "order"."handed_to_shipping_at" IS NULL
            OR
            ("order"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "order"."delivered_at" >= "order"."handed_to_shipping_at")
          ))
        OR
        ("order"."fulfillment_status" = 'cancelled'
          AND "order"."handed_to_shipping_at" IS NULL
          AND "order"."delivered_at" IS NULL)
      )

telegram_connection_webhook_operation_co.name: telegram_connection_webhook_operation_consistency_check
telegram_connection_webhook_operation_co.value:
(
        ("telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_id" IS NULL
          AND "telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "telegram_connection"."webhook_operation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

merchant_invitation_terminal_state_check.name: merchant_invitation_terminal_state_check
merchant_invitation_terminal_state_check.value: NOT ("merchant_invitation"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_invitation"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
